Status: downloaded and verified only. NOT extracted/unpacked and NOT
grafted with morbinit or the Docker binaries yet, per task instructions

future work should extract it, then overlay guest/morbinit (once built,
see dist/CROSS_COMPILE.md) and the binaries in dist/guest-bin/ on top.
